correctness.rationale: The re-audited census partitions subalgebras into all subspaces of V and cosets over split invariant intersections. Mixed closure tests the projected inside subspace for invariance; outside closure tests the quotient coset difference for lying in either eigenspace. Graph-lift and intersection factors give all ordered counts. For fixed a,b Gaussian degrees make the inside population dominate except (2,2) and (2,3)/(3,2). At those exceptions the generic allowed type counts are respectively 1+2+7 out of 25 and 4+2+1 out of 16, with nongeneric intersections lower order. The corrected swap argument uses [x,y]_D+[x,y]_(I−D)=αy−βx, for x=αh+v and y=βh+w; both brackets belong to any subspace containing x,y together or neither does. Zero and one remain distinct in characteristic two. Independently enumerating ambient subspaces by extensions and testing closure directly gave (T,P)=(188,29140),(696,337248),(935,677413) for (a,b,q)=(2,2,2),(2,2,3),(2,3,2), and the separate coordinate-class expansion agreed with the special-case polynomials.
residual_risks: The brute-force cases are prime-field diagnostics; prime-power generality and the limiting claims rest on the field-independent structural proof.

evidence: Commutativity degree here is the pair count for bracket-in-sum, not elementwise commutation. Scalar shifts add a linear combination of the two inputs to their bracket; rescaling the whole bracket preserves containment. Hence two distinct scalar eigenvalues (including simultaneous nonzero actions) are equivalent for this invariant to the normalized projection, though not necessarily isomorphic Lie algebras.

value.rationale: This is an exact census for a natural next family beyond rank-one and scalar adjoint actions. It explains which higher-rank multiplicities still balance abelian-ideal subalgebras against exterior ones, and separates the two such probability limits from the full-probability range. The ordered pair formula also gives finite-field values before any asymptotic approximation.
residual_risks: The result does not extend to varied dimensions with q, nonsplit actions, or more distinct eigenvalues.
